# signed zero / NaN in untyped-vs-double comparisons (Saxon: Double.compare semantics)
xs:untypedAtomic('0') = -0e0
xs:untypedAtomic('0') != -0e0
xs:untypedAtomic('0') > -0e0
xs:untypedAtomic('-0') = -0e0
xs:untypedAtomic('-0') = 0
xs:untypedAtomic('NaN') = xs:double('NaN')
xs:untypedAtomic('NaN') > 1e0
xs:untypedAtomic('0.00') = (round(sum((xs:untypedAtomic('-0.00'))) * 10 * 10) div 100)
0e0 = -0e0
xs:double('0') = -0e0
# error tolerance
(1 = 1) or (xs:decimal('x') = 1)
(xs:decimal('x') = 1) or (1 = 1)
(xs:decimal('x') = 1) and (1 = 2)
(xs:decimal('x') = 1) and (1 = 1)

(xs:decimal(//a:line[1]/a:code) = 1) and (1 = 1)
